rules.title: Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance
rules.requirement: Owners must pay tenants relocation assistance for an owner move-in eviction. The payment is indexed to inflation and the Rent Board publishes the yearly increase; for 2026 the standard payment is $19,413 and the additional payment for qualifying households is $6,471.
rules.key_value: $19,413 standard relocation payment; $6,471 additional for qualifying households (effective 2026-01-01, a 1.5% CPI increase)
rules.citation: Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance
rules.status_basis: 2026 annual adjustment goes into effect January 1, 2026; approved by Rent Board October 16, 2025. The effective date is that of the adjustment, not of the ordinance.

requires.name: owner_move_in_eviction
requires.text: in the event of an owner move-in eviction

coverage.summary: Applies to tenants evicted so the owner can move in.

rules.quoted_span: The Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance requires owners to pay tenants relocation assistance in the event of an owner move-in eviction.

rules.title: Ellis Implementation Ordinance
rules.requirement: Owners who evict tenants to remove a property from the rental market must pay the same relocation assistance as for owner move-in evictions. The payment is indexed to inflation; for 2026 the standard payment is $19,413 and the additional payment for qualifying households is $6,471.
rules.key_value: $19,413 standard relocation payment; $6,471 additional for qualifying households (effective 2026-01-01)
rules.status_basis: 2026 annual adjustment goes into effect January 1, 2026. The effective date is that of the adjustment, not of the ordinance.

requires.name: ellis_act_withdrawal
requires.text: tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market

coverage.summary: Applies to Ellis Act evictions removing a property from the rental market.

rules.quoted_span: The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.
